thread:
Priya K: Quick sync — we need to pin capacity slots for Q4 private pilots (Beacon + Lumen). Can product/eng/runtime/infra/security confirm sequencing constraints by EOD? Need final order for capacity reservations and staging windows.
Sam W: Heads up — eng is pretty packed the week of Nov 8-14. If customers insist on Nov targets we either push start 2 weeks or do a hosted-first path.
Raj P: Dedicated pool is doable but requires committed GPU slab: 4xA100 for Beacon, 2xA100 for Lumen. Lead time ~10 business days to provision in staging region. We can try a soft-reserve while contracts are finalized.
Anika R: Runtime note — model variant choice impacts prewarm. If Beacon runs 70k token sequences we need KV-cache warmup and prewarm slots. Recommend canary with quantized variant first.
Emily S: Security: Lumen's PII lane needs KMS/HSM integration + SOC2 signoff. Also threat model review required. Estimate ~7 days after docs are in.
Matt L: Customer timeline: Beacon asking for beta by Nov 21. Is that realistic given infra ETA?
Priya K: If infra can't meet Nov 21, can we do a hosted-first week then migrate to dedicated? Need tradeoffs spelled out.
Devin H: SRE perspective — hosted-first works but we'll hit rate limits. We'll need token quotas and circuit breakers. Observability: tracing + token-level cost logs must be on from day one.
Olivia M: Also need rollback playbook and canary thresholds (suggest 5% traffic, 48h). Make sure runbooks include fast-fail criteria.
Anika R: Proposed rollout: 1) Hosted canary (quantized) 2) Dedicated soft-reserve + prewarm 3) Migrate full traffic. Draft runtime config snippet:
```
batch_size: auto
kv_warm: true
prewarm_slots: 3
fallback_variant: quantized-v1
```
Sam W: I'll block non-critical infra deploys during the prewarm window (Nov 9-12) so we can reallocate GPU capacity.
Raj P: With a freeze, infra can reassign GPUs faster. Still waiting on signed MSA for Lumen before we fully provision.
Emily S: I'll prioritize the threat-model review; please upload required docs to the security folder (link in DMs). Need clarity on Beacon data retention policy too.
Priya K: Action items: Raj confirm soft-reserve ETA, Emily confirm threat-model ETA, Anika post runtime config + fallback, Sam schedule deploy freeze, Devin/Olivia publish canary thresholds. I'll consolidate and update customers.
Matt L: If we miss Nov 21, fallback offer: phased access with reduced concurrency and longer pilot window. I'll notify customers and get alignment.
Priya K: :thumbsup: Reconvene tomorrow 10:00 PT. If you can't make it, drop updates in this thread.
deploy-bot: freeze scheduled Nov 9 00:00 - Nov 12 23:59 in staging (auto-applied).
